takes.sourceDescription: sit on high stool, stand up
takes.title: Sit High and Stand Up Again
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly approaches a high seated position, settling with hands by the hips or on the thighs before rising. The last rise ends in an upright step.

takes.sourceDescription: sit on high stool, stand up
takes.title: Alternate High Sitting and Standing
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves into several high seated poses, bracing the hands near the hips or placing them on the thighs between rises. They finish with a brief turn and a bent-knee step.

takes.sourceDescription: sit on high stool, stand up
takes.title: Sit High from Several Angles
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates upright steps with several high seated poses, including side-facing sits with the feet drawn back. The take ends in another bent-knee seated position.

takes.sourceDescription: sit on stepstool, chin in hand
takes.title: Sit Low and Rest the Chin on a Hand
takes.actionDescription: The performer lowers into a squat-height seated pose, shifts orientation, and brings one hand to the chin. They repeat the low sit and finish by stepping away.

takes.sourceDescription: sit on stepstool, hands against chin, fidget, stand up
takes.title: Sit Low, Fidget, and Sit Again
takes.actionDescription: The performer sits low with hands near the chin, changes hand and torso positions, and rises between repetitions. The take ends seated with the hands gathered in front.

takes.sourceDescription: sit on stepstool, hands against chin, elbow out, stand up
takes.title: Sit Low with an Elbow Set Out
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates between standing and low sits, changing from an elbow-out posture to a raised hand and a side-facing sit. They finish standing in profile.

takes.title: Mime Opening a Bottle and Drinking
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings the hands together in front of the chest, then repeatedly raises one hand toward the mouth while standing. The CMU source identifies the hand motions as opening a bottle and drinking.

takes.sourceDescription: unscrew bottlecap, drink soda, screw on bottlecap
takes.title: Mime Opening, Drinking, and Recapping a Bottle
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with hands together, raises one hand to the mouth in several intervals, and finishes with both hands together near the chest. The CMU source identifies a bottle cap.

takes.title: Mime Taking Several Sips While Standing
takes.actionDescription: From a wide stance, the performer repeatedly lifts one hand to the mouth and tips the head back. They lower the arm and return upright at the end.

takes.sourceDescription: jump up to grab, reach for, tiptoe
takes.title: Reach and Spring Upward Repeatedly
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright and alternates one-handed reaches with two-handed overhead reaches and small upward springs. The final pose has both arms extended high.

takes.title: Make a Short Forward Jump and Settle
takes.actionDescription: The performer dips and swings the arms back, jumps forward, and absorbs the landing before returning to standing.

takes.sourceDescription: jump up to grab, reach for, tiptoe
takes.title: Repeat High Reaches with a Side Leg Lift
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly reaches above the head from standing, adding small jumps and a sideways leg lift mid-take. The take ends with both hands still high.

takes.title: Jump Forward from a Deep Dip
takes.actionDescription: The performer folds into a deep dip, springs into a fully extended airborne pose, and catches the landing with bent knees. They finish upright.

takes.title: Act Out Laughing with Broad Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer shifts between standing stances, raising a hand toward the face and opening the arms in brief emphatic gestures. The last pose has one hand still extended.

takes.title: Act Out Laughing with a Forward Bend
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with arms lowered, shifts weight and raises a hand toward the face, then bends sharply forward and straightens. They finish upright with one arm lifted.

takes.title: Act Out Laughing with Both Hands Raised
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens with both hands high, changes to hand-near-head gestures, and folds forward with hands low. The take ends in a bent-knee stance with arms extended in front.

takes.title: Mime a Boxing Sequence with Short Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with hands raised, alternates short steps and arm extensions while turning, then lowers the hands as the sequence winds down.

takes.title: Mime Boxing with Repeated Forward Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts hands-up, alternates outward arm extensions with wider steps and body turns, and finishes with hands drawn in and feet apart.

takes.title: Dip, Jump Forward, and Return to Standing
takes.actionDescription: The performer stands, dips with both arms back, jumps forward with arms raised, and settles upright after landing.

takes.title: Mime Window Washing with Repeated High Reaches
takes.actionDescription: From standing, the performer repeatedly lifts one hand above shoulder height, lowers it past the face, and shifts between feet. The final pose keeps the hand near the head.

takes.title: Alternate Low and High Window-Washing Motions
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts leaning forward, alternates low forward reaches with hand sweeps around forehead height, and straightens into a wide stance with arms lowered.

takes.title: Repeat One-Handed Wiping Arcs
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts with one hand already raised and traces repeated diagonal arcs while shifting weight and turning slightly. The hand remains extended in the last pose.

takes.title: Mime Sweeping with Forward Bends
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates upright resets with pronounced forward bends and low arm strokes. The take ends upright with the hands gathered near the upper torso.

takes.title: Mime Sweeping While Turning
takes.actionDescription: The performer bends and makes short low strokes, straightens between passes, and turns through several headings. The final pose is still bent forward.

takes.title: Mime Sweeping in a Side-Facing Stance
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens upright, leans and makes repeated low sweeping motions with bent knees, and finishes side-facing with the hands extended in front.

takes.title: Wave and Signal in Several Directions
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, extends both arms forward, and alternates high and low signals while turning. They finish facing forward with hands drawn toward the chest.

takes.title: Point and Sweep Both Arms Wide
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens with hands together, directs several gestures to the side, then opens both arms wide and turns through smaller signals. The arms lower at the end.

takes.title: Give Repeated Pointing and Overhead Signals
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts standing, alternates forward points with higher single-arm signals, and shifts stance while changing direction. One arm remains in front as the take ends.

takes.sourceDescription: jumping jacks, side twists, bend over, squats
takes.title: Do Jumping Jacks, Trunk Turns, and Squats
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves through repeated feet-apart arm raises, extends the arms during trunk turns, and lowers into deep squats before rising. The last pose is upright with one arm out.

takes.sourceDescription: jumping jacks, side twists, squats, jog
takes.title: Do Jumping Jacks, Twists, and Jogging Steps
takes.actionDescription: The take opens with arms overhead and feet apart, then moves into side turns, knee lifts, and short jogging steps. The performer returns to standing.

takes.sourceDescription: jumping jacks, side twists, bend over, jog
takes.title: Combine Jumping Jacks, a Side Bend, and Jogging
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, raises and opens the arms and lifts the knees, then reaches down and across in a deep bend. They rise and continue quick steps and arm swings.

takes.title: Jump Forward and Land Compactly
takes.actionDescription: The performer sinks into a crouch, springs forward with bent elbows, and lands with the feet close before standing upright.

takes.title: Repeat a High-Knee Ladder Climb
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates high knee lifts and forward hand reaches in several climbing motions. They lower between repetitions and finish upright in profile.

takes.title: Step Up and Down in Short Passes
takes.actionDescription: From a slight forward lean, the performer steps upward in a short series and back down, then repeats while changing orientation. They finish stepping side-on.

takes.title: Climb Three Steps with a Side-Facing Start
takes.actionDescription: The performer turns into profile, raises the knees to step up, and changes direction to descend. The last pose remains slightly bent at the knees in profile.

takes.title: Step Up, Turn, and Step Down with Arms Out
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, turns and climbs in short steps, then descends while shifting the arms outward. The last pose has a lifted knee and one arm away from the body.

takes.title: Repeat Short Stair Passes and Settle
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-step, lifts the knees to move upward, and then steps down while alternating profile and forward-facing poses. They finish standing.

takes.title: Jump in Place with Arms Open
takes.actionDescription: The performer dips, springs upward and opens both arms out, then absorbs the landing and resumes a neutral stance.

takes.title: Make a Compact Vertical Jump
takes.actionDescription: The performer stands briefly, bends the knees with arms low, and rises into a compact jump. They land and stand with the arms near the sides.

takes.title: Dip, Jump Vertically, and Open the Arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer drops into a crouch with the hands in front, jumps straight up while extending the arms outward, and lands with soft knees. They straighten to finish.

takes.title: Jump Vertically from a Deep Crouch
takes.actionDescription: The performer folds down sharply with the arms pulled behind, then jumps upward and lowers the arms while landing. The take ends upright.
